title: helianthemum cinereum
intro: Helianthemum cinereum, commonly known as Rockrose or Frostweed, is a low-growing, spreading perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its small, white, pink or purple flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum cinereum include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
